raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## What

Build the pinned `mamba-ssm` v2.3.0 and `causal-conv1d` v1.6.0 CUDA extensions once in the CUDA test image, instead of from source in every job that needs them. `Language Models (Hybrid)`, `Granite Language Model Compatibility` and `Language Models (Extended Generation)` then only verify the prebuilt packages.

Takes over @khluu's #52333, rebased onto current `main`: his three commits are kept as-is, with authorship, and one commit on top adapts them.

## Old

Each NVIDIA job ran two source builds before pytest:

```text
rm -rf /tmp/mamba-src && git clone --depth 1 --branch v2.3.0 .../mamba /tmp/mamba-src && sed -i 's/-std=c++17/-std=c++20/g' ... && MAMBA_FORCE_BUILD=TRUE uv pip install ... /tmp/mamba-src
CAUSAL_CONV1D_FORCE_BUILD=TRUE uv pip install ... 'git+https://github.com/Dao-AILab/causal-conv1d@v1.6.0'
```

## New

- `docker/Dockerfile`, `test-deps` stage: the same two builds, run once per image and cached with the stable dependency layer. arm64 images skip them because no arm64 job runs these tests. Release images (`vllm-openai`) are unaffected.
- The three NVIDIA jobs run `python3 ../.buildkite/scripts/check-hybrid-test-deps.py` instead. The script (from #52333) asserts both versions, imports both packages, and records where each came from.
- AMD mirrors and `test-amd.yaml` are unchanged. They use the ROCm mamba fork on a different image.

| Commit | Author | Change |
|---|---|---|
| Prebuild hybrid model test dependencies | khluu | Dockerfile step |
| Verify prebuilt hybrid test dependencies | khluu | verifier script |
| Report hybrid dependency source commits | khluu | PEP 610 source identities |
| Prebuild … with the C++20 mamba checkout; drop per-job builds | this PR | see Notes |

## Notes

- **Adapted to `main`.** Since #49600 the jobs build mamba from a checkout patched to `-std=c++20`, because torch ≥ 2.14 nightly needs it. #52333's plain `git+…@v2.3.0` would no longer build, so the Dockerfile uses the same patched checkout. The verifier therefore checks that mamba came from that checkout, since a local install has no VCS identity. causal-conv1d keeps its VCS check.
- **One check, at runtime.** #52333 also asserted the versions during the image build. Both installs are pinned to exact tags, and the jobs' verifier checks versions, imports and sources, so the build-time assert is dropped. The Hybrid job's `GIT_CONFIG` HTTP/1.1 env stays as on `main`; its mirror inherits it for the ROCm source installs.
- **A failed prebuild fails only these jobs.** Every CI job uses this image, so the `RUN` step warns and continues instead of failing the image build. `check-hybrid-test-deps.py` then fails the three jobs with a pointer to the image build log, so the break shows where it is. The two fetches are tried twice, because a successful `RUN` is cached, and causal-conv1d is built with `--no-cache`, because uv keys a git build by commit, not by the torch it was built against.
- **No test or topology change.** Same commands, same replicas, same keys.
- AI assistance was used (Claude Code). Checks run: `pre-commit run` on the changed files, which includes the Dockerfile dependency-graph and `docker/versions.json` hooks, plus `yaml.safe_load` on both pipeline files.

## Validation on the rebased head

| Build | Image | Result |
|---|---|---|
| [92686](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/92686) | stable torch | Image built both packages, no warning. Hybrid (2 shards), Granite and Extended Generation passed, each verifying the prebuilt packages first; non-pytest overhead about 1 min per job. No retries. |
| [92676](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/92676) | torch nightly (`TORCH_NIGHTLY=1`) | Image built both packages against nightly torch; the Granite job verified them. Its test then failed with `Free memory on device cuda:0 ... is less than desired GPU memory utilization`, the same failure main's nightly runs of this step show ([92599](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/92599), [92398](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/92398)), so it is not caused by this PR. |

## Runtime and overhead (measured)

Measured in validation build [91320](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/91320) ([comment](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/58795#issuecomment-5840486186)) against `main` build [91274](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/91274):

| Job | pytest | running wall (main → this PR) | non-pytest overhead (main → this PR) | main overhead cause |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Hybrid Shard 1 | 19.1m | 33.9m → 20.8m | 17.0m → 1.7m | mamba + causal-conv1d source builds |
| Hybrid Shard 2 | 33.1m | 47.6m → 34.6m | 15.9m → 1.5m | same |
| Granite Compatibility | 3.4m | 18.8m → 4.7m | 14.9m → 1.3m | same |
| Extended Generation | 48.3m | not in recent `main` builds → 50.1m | same two builds → 1.6m | same |

- Worker-minutes per build that runs these jobs: Hybrid −26.1, Granite −14.1, Extended about −15 (estimate).
- Image build: the new dependency layer took 13.9m cold, which made `:docker: Build image` 15.7m instead of 5.5–7.4m. It is free once cached, and paid again only when its inputs change.
- Enables the Hybrid named-job split stacked on #58771 to stay within the extra-worker-minute budget.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

## Validation

Build [91320](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/91320) on head `ba40c99615` (0 behind `main`), scoped to `language-models-tests-hybrid`, `language-models-tests-granite-l4-compatibility`, `language-models-test-extended-generation`. The mirrors are not included because their commands, inherited env and image are unchanged.

**All 5 test jobs passed on the first attempt, with no automatic retries.** In every job, the verifier printed `mamba_ssm==2.3.0@v2.3.0-c++20` and `causal_conv1d==1.6.0@da6dbaa9fd5a…`, and no source build ran.

| Job | pytest | running wall | non-pytest overhead | `main` [91274](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/91274) wall / overhead |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Hybrid Shard 1 | 19.1m | 20.8m | 1.7m | 33.9m / 17.0m |
| Hybrid Shard 2 | 33.1m | 34.6m | 1.5m | 47.6m / 15.9m |
| Granite Compatibility | 3.4m | 4.7m | 1.3m | 18.8m / 14.9m |
| Extended Generation | 48.3m | 50.1m | 1.6m | not in recent `main` builds (optional); ran the same two source builds |

- Non-pytest overhead per job: 15–17m → 1.3–1.7m, as predicted.
- Worker-minutes: Hybrid 81.5 → 55.4 (**−26.1**), Granite 18.8 → 4.7 (**−14.1**), and Extended about −15 whenever it runs (estimated from the removed builds; no matched baseline). Pytest times are unchanged within run-to-run variation.
- Slowest Hybrid replica: 47.6m → 34.6m wall.

**Image build: one-time cost measured on a cold layer.** `:docker: Build image` took 15.7m, against 5.5–7.4m on recent `main` builds. The new `test-deps` step took 13.9m (mamba 4.3m, causal-conv1d 9.5m with a cold uv cache). The vLLM compile was cached in this build, so the step ran on the critical path rather than hiding behind it. Once the layer is cached, builds pay nothing. The layer rebuilds only when its inputs change (`requirements/`, the runtime base, torch pins). I'm looking at keying these two builds on torch/CUDA alone, so a requirements-only change does not rebuild them.

Runtime verdict: no job slower, every affected job faster. Cost verdict: about −40 worker-minutes per build that runs these jobs, plus about +14 min of image build whenever the dependency layer is rebuilt without a vLLM compile.

detail.body:
## What

Build the pinned `mamba-ssm` v2.3.0 and `causal-conv1d` v1.6.0 CUDA extensions once in the CUDA test image, instead of from source in every job that needs them. `Language Models (Hybrid)`, `Granite Language Model Compatibility` and `Language Models (Extended Generation)` then only verify the prebuilt packages.

Takes over @khluu's #52333, rebased onto current `main`: his three commits are kept as-is, with authorship, and one commit on top adapts them.

## Old

Each NVIDIA job ran two source builds before pytest:

```text
rm -rf /tmp/mamba-src && git clone --depth 1 --branch v2.3.0 .../mamba /tmp/mamba-src && sed -i 's/-std=c++17/-std=c++20/g' ... && MAMBA_FORCE_BUILD=TRUE uv pip install ... /tmp/mamba-src
CAUSAL_CONV1D_FORCE_BUILD=TRUE uv pip install ... 'git+https://github.com/Dao-AILab/causal-conv1d@v1.6.0'
```

## New

- `docker/Dockerfile`, `test-deps` stage: the same two builds, run once per image and cached with the stable dependency layer. arm64 images skip them because no arm64 job runs these tests. Release images (`vllm-openai`) are unaffected.
- The three NVIDIA jobs run `python3 ../.buildkite/scripts/check-hybrid-test-deps.py` instead. The script (from #52333) asserts both versions, imports both packages, and records where each came from.
- AMD mirrors and `test-amd.yaml` are unchanged. They use the ROCm mamba fork on a different image.

| Commit | Author | Change |
|---|---|---|
| Prebuild hybrid model test dependencies | khluu | Dockerfile step |
| Verify prebuilt hybrid test dependencies | khluu | verifier script |
| Report hybrid dependency source commits | khluu | PEP 610 source identities |
| Prebuild … with the C++20 mamba checkout; drop per-job builds | this PR | see Notes |

## Notes

- **Adapted to `main`.** Since #49600 the jobs build mamba from a checkout patched to `-std=c++20`, because torch ≥ 2.14 nightly needs it. #52333's plain `git+…@v2.3.0` would no longer build, so the Dockerfile uses the same patched checkout. The verifier therefore checks that mamba came from that checkout, since a local install has no VCS identity. causal-conv1d keeps its VCS check.
- **One check, at runtime.** #52333 also asserted the versions during the image build. Both installs are pinned to exact tags, and the jobs' verifier checks versions, imports and sources, so the build-time assert is dropped. The Hybrid job's `GIT_CONFIG` HTTP/1.1 env stays as on `main`; its mirror inherits it for the ROCm source installs.
- **A failed prebuild fails only these jobs.** Every CI job uses this image, so the `RUN` step warns and continues instead of failing the image build. `check-hybrid-test-deps.py` then fails the three jobs with a pointer to the image build log, so the break shows where it is. The two fetches are tried twice, because a successful `RUN` is cached, and causal-conv1d is built with `--no-cache`, because uv keys a git build by commit, not by the torch it was built against.
- **No test or topology change.** Same commands, same replicas, same keys.
- AI assistance was used (Claude Code). Checks run: `pre-commit run` on the changed files, which includes the Dockerfile dependency-graph and `docker/versions.json` hooks, plus `yaml.safe_load` on both pipeline files.

## Validation on the rebased head

| Build | Image | Result |
|---|---|---|
| [92686](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/92686) | stable torch | Image built both packages, no warning. Hybrid (2 shards), Granite and Extended Generation passed, each verifying the prebuilt packages first; non-pytest overhead about 1 min per job. No retries. |
| [92676](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/92676) | torch nightly (`TORCH_NIGHTLY=1`) | Image built both packages against nightly torch; the Granite job verified them. Its test then failed with `Free memory on device cuda:0 ... is less than desired GPU memory utilization`, the same failure main's nightly runs of this step show ([92599](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/92599), [92398](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/92398)), so it is not caused by this PR. |

## Runtime and overhead (measured)

Measured in validation build [91320](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/91320) ([comment](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/58795#issuecomment-5840486186)) against `main` build [91274](https://buildkite.com/vllm/ci/builds/91274):

| Job | pytest | running wall (main → this PR) | non-pytest overhead (main → this PR) | main overhead cause |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Hybrid Shard 1 | 19.1m | 33.9m → 20.8m | 17.0m → 1.7m | mamba + causal-conv1d source builds |
| Hybrid Shard 2 | 33.1m | 47.6m → 34.6m | 15.9m → 1.5m | same |
| Granite Compatibility | 3.4m | 18.8m → 4.7m | 14.9m → 1.3m | same |
| Extended Generation | 48.3m | not in recent `main` builds → 50.1m | same two builds → 1.6m | same |

- Worker-minutes per build that runs these jobs: Hybrid −26.1, Granite −14.1, Extended about −15 (estimate).
- Image build: the new dependency layer took 13.9m cold, which made `:docker: Build image` 15.7m instead of 5.5–7.4m. It is free once cached, and paid again only when its inputs change.
- Enables the Hybrid named-job split stacked on #58771 to stay within the extra-worker-minute budget.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+
+import json
+import sys
+from importlib.metadata import PackageNotFoundError, distribution, version
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    try:
+        mamba_version = version("mamba_ssm")
+        causal_conv_version = version("causal_conv1d")
+    except PackageNotFoundError as missing:
+        sys.exit(
+            f"{missing.name} is not in this test image: docker/Dockerfile's "
+            "mamba-ssm/causal-conv1d build failed. Its error is in this "
+            "build's :docker: Build image log, above the warning "
+            '"mamba-ssm/causal-conv1d were not built".'
+        )
+    assert mamba_version == "2.3.0", mamba_version
+    assert causal_conv_version == "1.6.0", causal_conv_version
+
+    # Importing loads each package's CUDA extension, so a build against a
+    # different torch fails here rather than in the tests.
+    import causal_conv1d
+    import mamba_ssm
+
+    # docker/Dockerfile builds mamba from a C++20-patched v2.3.0 checkout, so it
+    # has no VCS identity; check it came from that checkout instead.
+    mamba_url_text = distribution("mamba_ssm").read_text("direct_url.json")
+    assert mamba_url_text is not None
+    assert json.loads(mamba_url_text)["url"].endswith("/tmp/mamba-src")
+
+    causal_conv_url_text = distribution("causal_conv1d").read_text("direct_url.json")
+    assert causal_conv_url_text is not None
+    causal_conv_url = json.loads(causal_conv_url_text)
+    assert (
+        causal_conv_url["url"].removesuffix(".git")
+        == "https://github.com/Dao-AILab/causal-conv1d"
+    )
+    vcs_info = causal_conv_url["vcs_info"]
+    assert vcs_info["requested_revision"] == "v1.6.0"
+    causal_conv_commit = vcs_info["commit_id"]
+    assert len(causal_conv_commit) == 40
+    assert all(
+        character in "0123456789abcdefABCDEF" for character in causal_conv_commit
+    )
+
+    print(
+        "Verified hybrid test dependencies:",
+        f"mamba_ssm==2.3.0@v2.3.0-c++20 ({mamba_ssm.__file__})",
+        f"causal_conv1d==1.6.0@{causal_conv_commit} ({causal_conv1d.__file__})",
+    )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+# Hybrid-model tests require the CUDA extensions from these exact upstream
+# tags. Build them once in the stable test-dependency layer instead of once per
+# parallel GPU shard. No arm64 job runs these tests, so arm64 images skip them.
+# torch>=2.14 nightly requires C++20 for ATen headers (pytorch/pytorch#178150);
+# mamba@v2.3.0 pins -std=c++17, so build from a patched checkout instead of the git URL.
+# A failed build does not fail the image, which every CI job uses: the jobs that
+# need these run .buildkite/scripts/check-hybrid-test-deps.py first, and it fails
+# them. Network steps are tried twice, because a successful RUN is cached. uv's
+# cache keys a git build by commit, not by the torch it was built against, so
+# causal-conv1d skips the cache.
+RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/opt/uv/cache \
+    if [ "$TARGETPLATFORM" != "linux/arm64" ]; then \
+        twice() { "$@" || { sleep 30; "$@"; }; }; \
+        ( twice sh -c 'rm -rf /tmp/mamba-src && git clone --depth 1 --branch v2.3.0 https://github.com/state-spaces/mamba /tmp/mamba-src' \
+          && sed -i 's/-std=c++17/-std=c++20/g' /tmp/mamba-src/setup.py \
+          && MAMBA_FORCE_BUILD=TRUE uv pip install --system --no-build-isolation /tmp/mamba-src \
+          && twice env CAUSAL_CONV1D_FORCE_BUILD=TRUE uv pip install --system --no-cache --no-build-isolation \
+              'git+https://github.com/Dao-AILab/causal-conv1d@v1.6.0' \
+        ) || echo "WARNING: mamba-ssm/causal-conv1d were not built; the hybrid-model jobs will fail check-hybrid-test-deps.py"; \
+        rm -rf /tmp/mamba-src; \
+    fi
+
 # image to run unit testing suite
 # note that this uses vllm installed by `pip`
 FROM test-deps AS test
